scenes.heading: River pier, dusk
scenes.summary: Mara arrives with a letter; Oren is closing up.

scenes.heading: On the ferry, mid-river, night
scenes.summary: The engine dies in the fog; Mara speaks of her sister.

scenes.heading: Far pier, night
scenes.summary: A woman waits; Mara steps off; Oren turns back.

characters.name: Mara
characters.description: Arrives with a suitcase and a letter.

characters.name: The Woman
characters.description: Waits at the far pier, face hidden by fog.

shots.action: Mara walks onto the river pier at dusk, suitcase in one hand, letter in the other.
shots.script_line: Mara reaches the river pier at dusk with a suitcase in one hand and a letter in the other.

shots.action: Oren coils the rope for the last crossing of the day.
shots.script_line: is already coiling the rope for the last crossing of the day

shots.action: Oren says they are closed. Mara holds up the letter; he reads it and folds it away.
shots.script_line: She holds up the letter. He reads it, folds it away, and says nothing.

shots.action: Halfway across, the engine coughs and dies and fog closes in around the little boat.
shots.script_line: the engine coughs and dies, and fog closes in around the little boat

shots.action: Oren kneels at the engine while Mara holds the lantern over his hands.
shots.script_line: Oren kneels at the engine while Mara holds the lantern steady over his hands.

shots.action: Mara says her sister lived on the far shore; Oren nods without looking up.
shots.script_line: "My sister lived over there," she says. Oren nods, not looking up.

shots.action: A woman waits under a street lamp at the far pier, her face hidden by the fog.
shots.script_line: a woman waits under a street lamp, her face hidden by the fog

shots.action: Mara steps off the ferry; Oren turns the boat back into the fog.
shots.script_line: Mara steps off the ferry. Oren turns the boat back into the fog.
